pick.name: Gamma
pick.why: Most polished prompt-to-deck workflow for non-designers, with PPTX/Google Slides export so decks are not locked in.
pick.free_limits: Free: 400 one-time credits at signup (+200 per referral), up to 10 slides per prompt, import PDF/PPTX, export PDF/PPTX/PNG/Google Slides; Free PDF/PPTX exports carry a 'Made with Gamma' badge. Plus 1,000 credits/mo (removes branding, 100 slides/prompt), Pro 4,000/mo (custom branding, analytics, domains), Ultra 20,000/mo. USD prices are localised and were not visible: the India page shows ₹400 / ₹950 / ₹7,833 per seat per month billed annually; secondary sources put Plus at ~$8-12 and Pro at ~$15-25 per month

best_free.name: Slidev
best_free.why: Best for technical talks/demos with live code; Claude Code writes it.

alts.name: Claude Design
alts.what: Generates decks on your design system; exports PPTX, PDF, Google Slides, HTML, Canva
alts.why: Decks that share a design system with prototypes and code; exports PPTX/PDF.

alts.name: Google Slides + Gemini
alts.why: Free Slides; Gemini features depend on plan.
alts.free_limits: Slides is free; the Gemini app's slide generation is available without a Google AI plan (standard limits); Gemini side panel in Slides depends on Workspace/Google AI plan

candidates.name: Claude Design
candidates.verdict: alt: decks tied to your design system

decision: Gamma is the fastest prompt-to-deck route for most founders; flip to Claude Design when decks must match a codebase design system, or Slidev for developer talks in markdown. Pricing for Gamma is unverified.
details: Gemini app slide generation is listed for users without a Google AI plan on Google's Gemini Apps limits page (checked 2026-10-28).

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
